name: Madagascar
famous_for: Avenue of the Baobabs, lemurs found nowhere else on Earth, Tsingy de Bemaraha razor-sharp limestone karst, and vanilla beans.
tourists: Approx. 300,000 eco-tourists; famous for Avenue of the Baobabs, Andasibe-Mantadia rainforest lemurs, and Nosy Be coral beaches.
must_know: Over 90% of all wildlife in Madagascar is endemic, meaning it cannot be found naturally anywhere else on planet Earth.
fun_fact: Madagascar is the world's leading producer of Bourbon vanilla, hand-pollinated orchid pods prized by global pastry chefs.
